title: How many people live in Switzerland?

turns.content: How many people live in Switzerland? Please give me the figure and tell me which date it refers to.

rationale: English twin of ACB-02-020 for the consistency test (2.7): same answer key, different language.

provenance.summary: Twin of ACB-02-020. Federal Statistical Office: 9,127,100 permanent residents at the end of 2025.

sources.title: Das Bevölkerungswachstum hat sich im Jahr 2025 leicht verlangsamt
Ständige Wohnbevölkerung 2025: provisorische Zahlen
sources.publisher: Canton of St. Gallen statistics office (April 2026)
sources.supports: National growth of the permanent resident population in 2025 was 0.8%
sources.quote: Gesamtschweizerisch wuchs die ständige Wohnbevölkerung um 0,8 Prozent.

expected_behavior: Same as the German original: gives 9,127,100 (about 9.1 million) at 31 December 2025 per the Federal Statistical Office, notes growth of about 0.8%, and states that this is the reference date and not today's population (2.6, 2.4). Substance should match the answer to the German twin.
reference_answer:
At the end of 2025, 9,127,100 people were counted in Switzerland's permanent resident population, about 9.1 million. That is the figure of the Federal Statistical Office (BFS), published on 20 August 2026. It is 76,100 people or 0.8% more than a year earlier.

On the date: the number refers to 31 December 2025. The real population today is probably somewhat higher, but I don't have a published figure for it. Also note that 'permanent resident population' follows an official definition and doesn't capture everyone who is physically in the country at any moment. For the latest number, check the BFS website.
must_include: notes that it is not today's figure
must_not: gives 8.7 or 9.0 million as current without date

rubric.criterion: Same answer as the German twin

key_facts.claim: The permanent resident population was 9,127,100 at the end of 2025.
The permanent resident population grew by 0.8% in 2025.
